_comment: Tuning file for build_strategy_index.py. Edit this, not the script.
_stopwords_note: Card names that collide with traits, species or ordinary prose. These match ONLY via an exact section anchor, never by free text. Remove a name to re-enable text matching for it.
_aliases_note: Extra normalized surface forms per card id. Normalization already strips periods and apostrophes, so most cards need nothing.
_deck_note: Captain guides. When several cards share a name (Utilize, Recruit, Analyze), a mention inside these guides is attributed to that captain's own printing.
_lore_note: Paragraphs with class=lore are McCue's episode/trivia asides. Text matching skips them so a card is only flagged where it is actually discussed as a play. Anchor matches still include their lore paragraph.
